Each working keyword is expanded into sibling phrases (vendors, named products, feature angles, Korean equivalents). Query ANGLES rotate by date so 08-20 does not repeat 08-19: yesterday led with generator platforms/foundation models, detection & distribution policy, mastering/mixing/stems, AI music video and AI DJ. Today leads with DAW-native and instrument/plugin tooling (Ableton, Logic, neural amp/synth, drum & sample generators), performance/DJ hardware, producer workflow case studies, and licensed-voice/licensing economics; platform-model queries are kept but pushed to a product-feature angle. Topics published 2026-08-11..08-19 are in avoid_topics and may only be re-approached from a genuinely new product or feature angle. YouTube channels rotate by day-of-month: (20 mod 6) + 1 = 3 -> Andrew Huang, Benn Jordan, Venus Theory (08-19 used Udio/ElevenLabs/Suno, so creator-side channels get the turn today).
